title: Chef John's Refried Beans
description: Chef John says the key to great refried beans is to make them with lard. Serve on, with, or in nachos, layered dips, quesadillas--the possibilities are endless.
ingredients: 1 pound dry pinto beans, soaked overnight

steps.text: Drain soaked beans and transfer them to a stock pot. Add garlic, epazote, and cold water. Place pot over high heat and bring to a boil. Stir. Reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered until beans are soft, 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Drain the beans and reserve all the liquid.

Melt lard in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions and salt; cook until onions start to brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in serrano pepper and chipotle powder; cook 1 minute. Transfer drained beans into skillet. Mash about half the beans with a potato masher or back of a spoon. Ladle some bean cooking liquid to skillet. Continue to mash and stir beans as you gradually add more liquid. Mash until the beans have reached your preferred consistency and texture. Taste and add more salt, if desired.

video.description: One of life’s great indulgences is greater when it’s homemade: salty, spicy refried beans. Learn from Chef John the great “re-frying” secret behind this delicious bean side dish. After soaking pinto beans in water overnight, add to a stockpot with fresh, cold water, garlic cloves and dried epazote, a Mexican herb. After simmering soft, add to a pot of onions softened in lard, diced serrano peppers and dried chipotle pepper. Then add liquid, cook and gently smash the beans until they’re the texture you crave. Garnish with queso fresco and fresh oregano, then serve in burritos, with rice, on nachos, on anything!
